name: Bugged
objectiveText: Kill Skyhoppers in Valanaar until you've eliminated 8 Enchanted Skyhoppers .   Enchanted Skyhopper Exterminated  ( 8 )

replies: Awesome, thank you! The target marking really helped a lot. I also sent my pet to attack if I still couldn't see it.

comments.body: These are not random. Look for skyhoppers near areas listening to people. Such as the tower or the inn, it will always be enchanted.
replies: I cannot find these. I have found 2 in the last 20 minutes.
I was just killing everyone, killed about 20 until I found the 8 needed for the quest.
It's all random. Just go around and kill Skyhoppers
Yeah I don't think this is true. I killed one in the inn with no credit, and one in a field that gave credit. I think it is random.

comments.body: If you're an idiot like me and couldn't figure out what Skyhoppers were, no, they are not anything akin to helicopters (so don't look for them in the sky... give me a break, ok). They are little bugs (like grasshoppers) that are all over the town. Yes, the macro /target Skyhopper is very useful!
